_description: Library of common PnP/SPO PowerShell scripts ready to send to the /api/InvokeScript endpoint. Each entry has a name, description, category, and the script payload.

scripts.name: Get Web Info
scripts.description: Returns the title, URL, and creation date of the connected web.
scripts.script: Get-PnPWeb | Select-Object Title, Url, Created, Description | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: List All Sites
scripts.description: Lists all site collections in the tenant with basic metadata.
scripts.script: Get-PnPTenantSite | Select-Object Url, Title, Template, Owner | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Detailed Site Inventory
scripts.description: Comprehensive site inventory with storage, sharing, and activity data.
scripts.script: Get-PnPTenantSite -Detailed | Select-Object Url, Title, Template, Owner, StorageUsageCurrent, StorageMaximumLevel, LastContentModifiedDate, LockState, SharingCapability, ConditionalAccessPolicy, GroupId | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3

scripts.name: Find Inactive Sites
scripts.description: Lists sites with no content modifications in the last 90 days.
scripts.script: $cutoff = (Get-Date).AddDays(-90); Get-PnPTenantSite -Detailed | Where-Object { $_.LastContentModifiedDate -lt $cutoff } | Select-Object Url, Title, LastContentModifiedDate, StorageUsageCurrent | Sort-Object LastContentModifiedDate | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Storage Usage Report
scripts.description: Top 20 sites by storage usage with quota information.
scripts.script: Get-PnPTenantSite -Detailed | Select-Object Url, @{N='UsageGB';E={[math]::Round($_.StorageUsageCurrent/1024,2)}}, @{N='QuotaGB';E={[math]::Round($_.StorageMaximumLevel/1024,2)}}, @{N='PercentUsed';E={if($_.StorageMaximumLevel -gt 0){[math]::Round(($_.StorageUsageCurrent/$_.StorageMaximumLevel)*100,1)}else{'Unlimited'}}} | Sort-Object UsageGB -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: List Non-Hidden Lists
scripts.description: Lists all non-hidden lists and libraries in the site with item counts.
scripts.script: Get-PnPList | Where-Object { -not $_.Hidden } | Select-Object Title, BaseTemplate, ItemCount, Created, LastItemModifiedDate | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Site Collection Admins
scripts.description: Lists all site collection administrators.
scripts.script: Get-PnPSiteCollectionAdmin | Select-Object Title, Email, LoginName | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Unique Permissions Audit
scripts.description: Finds all lists with unique (broken inheritance) permissions.
scripts.script: $lists = Get-PnPList -Includes HasUniqueRoleAssignments; $results = @(); foreach ($l in $lists) { if ($l.HasUniqueRoleAssignments) { $results += [PSCustomObject]@{ ListTitle = $l.Title; UniquePerms = $true } } }; $results | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Reset List Permissions
scripts.description: Resets all lists to inherit permissions from the parent site.
scripts.script: $lists = Get-PnPList -Includes HasUniqueRoleAssignments; $reset = @(); foreach ($l in $lists) { if ($l.HasUniqueRoleAssignments -and -not $l.Hidden) { Set-PnPList -Identity $l -ResetRoleInheritance; $reset += $l.Title } }; [PSCustomObject]@{ ResetLists = $reset; Count = $reset.Count } | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Hub Sites
scripts.description: Lists all hub sites in the tenant.
scripts.script: Get-PnPHubSite | Select-Object SiteId, SiteUrl, Title, Description | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Content Types
scripts.description: Lists all content types in the site.
scripts.script: Get-PnPContentType | Select-Object Name, Id, Group, Description | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Site Fields
scripts.description: Lists all custom site columns.
scripts.script: Get-PnPField | Where-Object { $_.FromBaseType -eq $false } | Select-Object Title, InternalName, TypeAsString, Group | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Sharing Capability Report
scripts.description: Reports sharing capability settings for all sites.
scripts.script: Get-PnPTenantSite | Select-Object Url, SharingCapability, ConditionalAccessPolicy, DenyAddAndCustomizePages | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Locked Sites
scripts.description: Finds all locked or read-only site collections.
scripts.script: Get-PnPTenantSite | Where-Object { $_.LockState -ne 'Unlock' } | Select-Object Url, Title, LockState | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Lock Site (Read-Only)
scripts.description: Sets a site collection to read-only mode. Change the -Identity URL to your target site.
scripts.script: Set-PnPTenantSite -Identity 'https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/TargetSite' -LockState 'ReadOnly'; Write-Output 'Site locked to read-only'

scripts.name: Unlock Site
scripts.description: Unlocks a site collection. Change the -Identity URL to your target site.
scripts.script: Set-PnPTenantSite -Identity 'https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/TargetSite' -LockState 'Unlock'; Write-Output 'Site unlocked'

scripts.name: Set Storage Quota
scripts.description: Sets storage quota on a site (5GB max, 4.5GB warning). Change the -Identity URL.
scripts.script: Set-PnPTenantSite -Identity 'https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/TargetSite' -StorageMaximumLevel 5120 -StorageWarningLevel 4608; Write-Output 'Storage quota set: 5GB max, 4.5GB warning'

scripts.name: Recycle Bin Report
scripts.description: Lists items in the site recycle bin with size information.
scripts.script: Get-PnPRecycleBinItem | Select-Object Title, ItemType, Size, DeletedByName, DeletedDate | Sort-Object Size -Descending | Select-Object -First 50 | ConvertTo-Json

scripts.name: Empty Recycle Bin
scripts.description: Clears the site recycle bin to reclaim storage.
scripts.script: Clear-PnPRecycleBinItem -All -Force; Write-Output 'Recycle bin cleared'

scripts.name: External Users
scripts.description: Lists external users who have access to the site.
scripts.script: Get-PnPExternalUser | Select-Object DisplayName, InvitedAs, AcceptedAs, WhenCreated | ConvertTo-Json
